title: add-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v13
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Add profiling baselines (v13) and an automated reporting pipeline for representative workload runs; improves comparability and integrates with Benchmark Lab dashboards.
description: Summary: Add profiling baselines (v13) for representative workload runners and a new reporting pipeline to produce nightly performance reports. Motivation: recent model and runtime changes changed latency distributions; we need a stable baseline and an automated report to detect regressions early. This PR introduces baseline artifacts for common workloads, updates representative runners to emit consistent metadata, and wires a GitHub Actions workflow that uploads reports to the internal reporting bucket and triggers dashboard ingestion. Changes: 1) profiling/baselines/v13: new baseline JSON artifacts derived from profiling runs on a standardized infra image; 2) benchmark-lab/runners: canonicalize runner output format (schema v2) and add tags for sequence-length distributions; 3) reporting pipeline: github workflow + small uploader utility that validates, signs, and pushes reports; 4) tests: unit and integration tests for parsing and uploader; 5) docs: README and runbook for interpreting v13 baselines. Backwards compatibility: runners still accept schema v1 but emit v2 by default; reporting workflow supports both schemas for a transition period. Deployment: this will be merged to main and the nightly job will be enabled on the Benchmark Lab org. Related: ENG-4821 (profiling baselines), ENG-4897 (reporting pipeline), SUP-1142 (customer-reported regression investigation).
